contract.same_owner_multiple_callbacks: A single plugin owner can register multiple distinct callbacks for the same event
contract.registration_independence: Each callback is retained as an independent listener entry
contract.delivery: All callbacks registered by the same owner receive the emitted event
contract.delivery_order: Callbacks are invoked in registration order
contract.registry_preservation: Multiple callbacks for the same owner remain independently represented in the registry
contract.emit_success: EventBus.emit() remains successful with multiple callbacks owned by the same plugin
contract.permission_enforcement: Each registration and event emission requires the events permission
